code:
Lakeview Facilities — 40 people, onboarding to ServiceNow for the first time

- 35 staff            -> submit requests
- 4 coordinators       -> triage & assign
- 1 department head    -> visibility, no triage work

Goal: zero to production-ready, using Chapters 1-7 only.
caption: A cumulative scenario, not a screenshot walkthrough.

steps.label: lakeview_facilities_staff
steps.sub: 35 requesters, base request-level access, no special role

steps.label: lakeview_facilities_coordinators
steps.sub: 4 triage staff, granted a custom facilities_coordinator role

steps.label: lakeview_facilities_manager
steps.sub: department head, coordinator role plus read-only reporting, made group manager

steps.label: The field
steps.sub: estimated_cost, a currency field coordinators use to flag spending over threshold

steps.label: Why not a UI Policy alone
steps.sub: client-side hiding only — doesn't stop a report, import, or integration from exposing it

steps.label: The real control
steps.sub: a field-level ACL requiring facilities_coordinator for both read and write

steps.label: Furniture Request catalog item
steps.sub: variable set + catalog UI policy, routed to the coordinators group

steps.label: Condition-based notification
steps.sub: state changes to Closed Complete -> email template to the requester automatically

subtitle: Form rules, system health, and moving to Production.
